name: command-demo
title: Command demo
description: An inline command list with groups, shortcuts and a disabled command.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Command, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandGroupHeading, CommandInput, CommandInputWrapper, CommandItem, CommandList, CommandSeparator, CommandShortcut, } from '@/ui/command/command'; /** * An inline command list with groups, shortcuts and a disabled command. * Focus stays in the search field; the arrow keys move the highlight and * Enter runs it. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-command-demo', imports: [ Command, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandGroupHeading, CommandInput, CommandInputWrapper, CommandItem, CommandList, CommandSeparator, CommandShortcut, NdIcon, ], template: `
No results found.
Suggestions
Calendar
Search emoji
Calculator
Settings
Profile ⌘P
Billing ⌘B
Settings ⌘S

{{ ran() }}

`, }) export class CommandDemoExample { protected readonly ran = signal(''); /** * Reports the command that ran. * * @param name - The command's name. */ protected run(name: string): void { this.ran.set(`Ran ${name}.`); } }
